description:
Hi everyone! 👋

We are Team MSA, and we're super excited to take on this year's NASA Space Apps Challenge! We're tackling the Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data challenge by building a smart "Super App." Our platform leverages NASA’s satellite telemetry data (soil moisture, weather insights, and crop adaptability) to guide farmers, while also incorporating an agricultural marketplace and a labor coordination hub to create a real social and economic impact.
